name: Adobe Premiere (mobile)
desc: Free mobile video editor with generative AI credits built in
desc_zh: 内置生成式 AI 额度的免费手机视频编辑器
solves: Desktop Premiere was too heavy for phone-shot clips; cut, add captions and generate on the phone you shot with.
solves_zh: 手机拍的短片用桌面版 Premiere 太重；直接在手机上剪辑、加字幕、生成画面。
best_for: Three travel clips are on your iPhone and Reels goes up tonight; rough the cut in Premiere mobile on the train.
best_for_zh: iPhone 里有三段旅行素材，今晚要发短视频；在路上用 Premiere 手机版先粗剪。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：A+D — App Store Photo & Video chart, then the Adobe Blog index）。 Outside the window but absent from the ledger; distinct from Premiere Pro on desktop (whose Generative Extend is already in the ledger). iOS launch 2025-09-30, Android 2026-09-22 (Android 13 and up per the post). Native mobile app; 'desktop' is used as the closest client form. Licensed music from UMG and WMG added 2026-11-10. Homepage moved from the desktop Premiere page to Adobe's mobile product page (/products/premiere/app.html, 'Free Video Editing App | Adobe Premiere'), which states the app is free and standalone; curl gets 403 from Adobe's bot guard, so the page was read through a page reader. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：这是手机应用；形态枚举没有手机应用，账本里手机应用记为 web。厂商没有公布中文名，name_zh 按 name。 首次公开日期来源：https://blog.adobe.com/en/publish/2025/09/30/now-available-adobe-premiere-iphone-brings-pro-quality-video-editing-creators
